verdict.rationale: Dynadot's API page says you can register, transfer, and renew domains through API commands. It also claims 120+ actions covering domains, DNS, and orders, so purchase-by-API is credible for a deploy script. However, the evidence never shows documented calls for setting registrant contacts or nameservers at registration time, and no machine-readable API spec was found. Missing for 10: explicit documented contact-creation/assignment calls, explicit nameserver-setting calls, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end scripted registration.
